title: 黛安娜·月刃高台
description: 黛安娜立于月光高台，银白长发与额心月印清楚，弧形月刃静垂身旁，完整衣甲被冷光描边。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Diana is an adult silver-haired Lunari woman with pale skin, light eyes, a crescent-shaped forehead mark, and curved silver armor details. Preserve her focused face and athletic adult proportions in a fully covering high-neck dark blue-purple tunic, opaque trousers, gauntlets, and boots. Her large crescent blade is held lowered beside her body, with its curve separated from her legs and no attack posture.
art_direction.scene: Place her in a still three-quarter stance on a broad elevated stone terrace, chin slightly raised toward the open night sky. One large circular architectural opening frames distant water without becoming a graphic halo. Concentrated cool light splits the silver armor and coarse wax-crayon folds into sharp planes, with a thin warm horizon and spare receding columns for depth.
art_direction.palette: silver white, midnight blue, pale violet, faint amber
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
